mapping_json.fidelity_notes: RNG-ELEMENT BOW: 'each attack rolls ONE random element at huge values; Combat Focus rings delete unwanted elements to force the roll' (mech_note; item_alterations: Combat Focus jewels block cold / block lightning). Geometry multi_projectile (bow projectile + small impact AoE, probe delivery 'projectile'). THE IDENTITY-BEARING MECHANIC — per-attack RANDOM element selection from a {fire,cold,lightning} pool, with build-defining threshold jewels that PRUNE the pool to force a single element — has NO engine lane: engine fixes ONE element per skill at generation time; there is no per-attack-random-element-roll primitive, nor an element-pool-pruning mechanic. Mapped to the ENDPOINT of the meta play (forced single fire via Combat Focus) = element_primary=fire + ELEMENT_CONVERSION_MONO (the mono-element lock IS the build's point, §5 element conversion). This is an APPROX: the map captures where the build LANDS (mono-fire bow burst) but LOSES the mechanic that defines the journey — the random-roll-then-prune-the-pool gameplay (the reason Combat Focus jewels exist). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (element-lock = mono conversion) + probe (mana-spend, projectile, burn) per fallback. A player of Elemental Hit would miss that their damage came from a randomized element pool they sculpted with jewels; the engine just gives them fire.
